runRules.title: Commands agents can run without asking
runRules.body: Agents run commands that need secrets with vibezeo run, which asks you first. A rule here lets that command run with any arguments, never chained, piped or redirected, while the folder's .env gives it the same secrets you last allowed. Worktrees use their folder's rules. A rule on a command that runs the repository's own scripts (pnpm deploy, npm run, make) lets the agent change what runs by editing those scripts. Since any arguments are allowed, some of them name another program, file or host (git push --receive-pack, make -f, npm --registry), and the repository's config changes what runs too (.npmrc, yarnPath in .yarnrc.yml, bunfig.toml, rust-toolchain.toml).

conductor.privacy: During a call, your voice goes to Vibezeo's voice service and its provider, Google's Gemini Live or a backup listed at vibezeo.com/privacy, with what Conductor reads to answer you: the names and titles of your panes, threads and teammates, and results such as an agent's closing message, redacted. Google's free service may keep what you say, use it to improve Google's products and have people review it, so keep private details off calls. Calls from the EEA, Switzerland and the UK never use it. Vibezeo's servers keep no recording. The wake phrase is detected on this computer.

conductor.memory.empty: Nothing remembered yet. Say "remember that…" during a call.
conductor.memory.emptyOff.body: Turn on "Remember things between calls" and Conductor keeps what you ask it to remember in a file you can read and edit here.
conductor.memory.forgetAll.title: Forget everything Conductor remembers?
conductor.memory.forgetAll.body: This deletes memory.md, any proposed memories and the call journal. It can't be undone.
conductor.wake.desc: Listens on this computer with the Dictate microphone, and steps aside while Dictate or a call is using it.

conductor.wake.paused.bluetooth_media: Paused while media plays on Bluetooth
conductor.wake.unavailable.benchmark_fai: Turned off: it didn't pass its false-trigger test
conductor.wake.pauseVideos.desc: Stops listening while anything is playing.
conductor.safety: Conductor asks before it closes agents, runs tasks or changes plugins. Shell commands, worktree removal, spending and Full access need a click on screen.

dictate.globe.consentBody: Vibezeo will set System Settings › Keyboard › "Press 🌐 key to" to Do Nothing, so holding Fn only dictates. It's set to {usage} now. You can undo this here, or change it back in System Settings.
dictate.setup.usingModel: Local · {name}. Free and private; works offline.

dictionary.review.emptyBody: As you dictate, names and terms that keep coming back show up here. Only Remember adds them.
dictionary.deleted.body: Deleted rules can be restored here for 30 days.
dictionary.test.title: Try your dictionary on sample text
dictionary.imported: {n, plural, one {# rule imported} other {# rules imported}}
dictionary.sync.title: Sync dictionary
dictionary.sync.help: Keeps your rules the same on your other computers through your Vibezeo account. Only the rules are sent: words, replacements and their options, never transcripts or audio.
dictionary.sync.conflicts: {n, plural, one {# rule was changed here and on another computer. Keep which one?} other {# rules were changed here and on another computer. Keep which ones?}}
dictionary.sync.offBody: Your rules stay on this computer. The synced copy stays in your Vibezeo account until you delete it, and your other computers keep their rules either way.
dictionary.preview.title: Import dictionary
dictate.unavailable: Dictate isn't available in this window.
plugins.intro: Connect a service once. Then choose which teammates can use it.
plugins.footer: Credentials stay in your system keychain. Teammates reach plugins only through Vibezeo.
plugins.previewTip: Not ready yet. We'll let you know when it is.
plugins.disconnectBody: All teammates lose access right away, turns using it will fail, and remembered approvals are cleared. The credential is removed from your keychain.
plugins.expired: {service} sign-in expired. Teammates can't use it until you reconnect.
plugins.keychainNote: The credential is saved only in your system keychain.
plugins.allThreads: Grant these plugins to all threads
plugins.allThreads.desc: Every thread can use these, on top of the plugins you add to a thread.
plugins.connect.title: Connect {service}
plugins.connect.noSignIn: This plugin needs no sign-in. It runs inside Vibezeo.
plugins.connect.reconnectNote: Your current connection stays as it is unless the new sign-in works.
plugins.connect.noTeammates: You have no teammates yet. Threads can use it once you add it to them.
plugins.connect.changeLater: You can change this any time.
plugins.policy.locked: Spending, deleting and unknown actions always ask.
plugins.policy.writesInFull: Let Full access chats run writes without asking
plugins.policy.publishInFull: Let Full access chats publish without asking
plugins.policy.unattended: Unattended runs (routines, tasks, mail) hold writes for you in Held actions.

threadPlugins.allThreads: Granted to all threads in Settings › Plugins.

dictate.engine.label: Transcribe with
dictate.engine.needsPro: Comes with Vibezeo accounts. It uses Vibezeo's servers and switches on when Vibezeo accounts open.
dictate.engine.cloudHelp: More languages. Audio is sent to Vibezeo's transcription service and uses about 8 credits a minute (daily cap 120 minutes).
dictate.engine.consentBody: While Cloud is on, each take's audio goes to Vibezeo's transcription service and isn't kept after transcription. Your history stays on this device.
dictate.toast.too_long_to_enhance: That's too long to enhance (5,000 characters max).
dictate.toast.enhance_failed: Enhance didn't work, so your exact words were used.
dictate.toast.polish_failed: Polish didn't work, so your exact words were used.
dictate.enhance.disclosureShort: Sends the transcript text (not audio) to Vibezeo's AI
dictate.enhance.disclosureTitle: Send the transcript to Vibezeo's AI?
dictate.enhance.disclosure: Enhance and Polish send the transcript text (not audio) to Vibezeo's AI service, even when you transcribe locally.
dictate.enhance.needsPro: Comes with Vibezeo accounts. It uses Vibezeo's servers and switches on when Vibezeo accounts open.
dictate.enhance.quickActions: Show Enhance and Polish after each take
dictate.enhance.formattingDesc: Applied to every take, as a Polish. An app can have its own.
dictate.enhance.perAppBody: These replace the general instructions when you dictate into that app. Use the app's identifier: its bundle id on macOS, executable name on Windows, or window class on Linux.
dictate.enhance.perAppEmpty: No app has its own instructions yet.
dictate.setup.linkHint: Here the global shortcut is the one you bind to {command} in your system settings: press it once to finish setup.
remote.phone.title: Phone
remote.phone.body: Check on agents, answer approvals, read threads and see the diff of work waiting for review (except .env files) from your phone's browser. Messages are end-to-end encrypted: the relay in between only passes sealed messages along.
remote.needsSignIn: Sign in to pair a phone.
remote.needsPro: The Vibezeo relay comes with Vibezeo accounts. It uses Vibezeo's servers and switches on when Vibezeo accounts open. Pair over your local network below.
remote.earlyAccess: The Vibezeo relay comes with Vibezeo accounts. It uses Vibezeo's servers and switches on when Vibezeo accounts open. Pair over your local network below: it needs no account.
remote.dialog.title: Pair a phone
remote.dialog.body: Scan this code with your phone's camera. It opens Vibezeo in your phone's browser, paired with this computer. The code expires in 10 minutes.
remote.dialog.bodyLan: Scan this code with your phone's camera, or with the Vibezeo Remote app. Your phone must be on the same network as this computer (or on the same VPN). The code expires in 10 minutes.
remote.lan.title: Local network
remote.lan.desc: This computer passes your phone's encrypted messages itself, so pairing needs no account. It listens only on your home or office network and VPN addresses, never on the internet. Off until you turn it on.
remote.lan.pair: Pair a phone on this network
remote.lan.away: Away from home? Put this computer and your phone on the same VPN (Tailscale's free plan works) and pair with its VPN address.
remote.dialog.link: Can't scan? Open this link on your phone:
remote.devices.emptyBody: Pair a phone to see your agents and answer approvals while you're away.
remote.grant.chat: Chat control: send messages to threads
remote.grant.terminal: Terminal control: type into agent panes, never plain shells
remote.grant.approvals: Approvals: answer them from the phone
remote.revoke.title: Revoke {device}?
remote.revoke.body: The phone is disconnected at once and its keys are deleted. Pair it again to use it.
remote.arm: Allow approvals from phone for the next 8 hours
remote.arm.desc: While this is on, Allow from a paired phone applies at once. Otherwise it waits for you here. Deny always applies.
remote.reset.title: Reset remote access?
remote.reset.body: Every paired phone is disconnected and must pair again.
